description: This file defines a Java interface 'ConnectionLogger' which provides methods for logging connection events, successes, failures, exceptions, and retrieving log entries. It includes static methods for obtaining an instance of the logger for a specific connection.

classes.name: ConnectionLogger
classes.description: An interface for logging and monitoring connection events, including success, failure, and exception logs. Provides static method to get an instance based on connection ID and config.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a ConnectionLogger instance for a given connection ID and configuration, by looking up the appropriate registry.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves all log entries stored in this logger.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Logs a successful event with optional message and arguments.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Logs a failure event with optional message, arguments, and exception.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Logs an exception event with optional message, arguments, or exception object.
